item.description:
NVBeacon is a native macOS menu bar app for monitoring remote NVIDIA GPU servers over SSH with `nvidia-smi`, process exit alerts, and GPU idle notifications.
- Added per-server Linux RAM used/total, available RAM, and Swap monitoring in the GPU popover, with high-usage color indicators. - Added a per-server memory query command in Advanced settings, alongside the GPU query command. - Added a saved popover width setting in Appearance, adjustable from 480 to 800 pt with a 500 pt default. The popover and its content now always use the same width. - Improved numeric settings so typing is not interrupted by range limits; values are validated on Return or when leaving the field. - Avoided restarting SSH polling for appearance changes, server renaming/reordering, and alert thresholds. Superseded settings updates and outdated collection results are ignored. - Added diagnostic information preview/copy from the current local state, excluding connection identifiers, custom commands, process details, and raw errors without running additional SSH queries. - Added versioned JSON server backup/export and reviewed import. Imports preserve existing settings and add disabled servers with fresh IDs, without restoring passwords or notification watches. - Restricted legacy shared-password recovery to the original migrated server so imported connections stay separate from existing credentials. - Fixed local app packaging to record the actual macOS SDK and preserve native settings styling. - Thanks @SAN-SHIa for contributing RAM/Swap monitoring and the popover width fix in #6.
